title: internal knowledge delegate

goal.text: Complete one dispatched knowledge finalization without interaction or recursive delegation.

requirements.summary: Wait for Stop capture, claim the immutable job, execute its generated assignment subplan sequentially, and persist one terminal result.
acceptanceCriteria: The job is located from the current project and supplied finalization id.
Only a successful claim can execute assignments.
Every assignment runs sequentially in the generated session-scoped subplan.
A successful claim always reaches exactly one terminal knowledge done call.

tasks.title: Wait for Stop capture
tasks.detail: Run `claw knowledge wait --project-root . --finalize-id <finalize-id>` from the current project using the exact finalization id supplied by dispatch. Allow at least 310 seconds for this command because it may wait up to 300 seconds for the parent Stop hook. This wait is only for job readiness; do not create or inspect a binding. Retain the returned jobPath.

tasks.title: Claim the knowledge job
tasks.detail: Run `claw knowledge claim --job <jobPath>`. Stop without executing assignments if claimed is false. Retain claimToken, templatePath, assignments, and immutable writer configuration. Do not execute any assignment before a successful claim.

tasks.title: Execute the assignment subplan
tasks.detail: Run `claw subplan create --parent "knowledge-finalizer-<first-12-finalize-id>" --task-id 3 --template-file <templatePath>`, deriving the parent from the exact finalization id supplied by dispatch, then follow the returned workflowGuidance. Execute each assignment yourself in order. Do not invoke a background finalizer, another writer agent, or a collaboration subagent.

tasks.title: Persist the terminal result
tasks.detail: After claim, call `claw knowledge done --job <jobPath> --claim-token <claimToken>` exactly once. A recovered orchestration command error does not make the job fail: use `--status succeeded --result <concise-result>` when every assignment eventually succeeded. If an orchestration error remains unrecovered or any assignment fails, use `--status failed --error <concise-error>`. Treat this as a finally-style obligation and then complete this delegate plan.

rules: Work unattended and never request user input, confirmation, or review.
Do not modify the supplied plan or report materials.
Do not switch between background and subagent execution policies.
Do not continue to later assignments after one fails.
